about: Expected port-suite failures on the one compiler. Each entry names the failing tests, why they fail, and the plan task that owns them (docs/migration/index.md). The port runner (scripts/ports.mjs) diffs failing-test sets against this ledger: a failure not listed here is a regression, and a listed failure that passes must be removed. Test names are exactly as the runner parses them; names in parentheses are the runner's pseudo-failures (docs/testing.md). Recorded from the pre-M1 fleet run of 2026-09-23 (binary ~/lilscript-work/bin/pre-m1/lilscript, 26 ports, 21 fully green) and re-checked with scripts/ports.mjs on 2026-09-24: the node:test spec reporter reports a failing test and its failing parent suite as two names; monacolil's check:site passes, so its entry was removed; react-markdownlil's build fails before any compile.
